answer_1.quote: Our research primarily investigates the factoid question-answering task, though the concept of distracting passages applies to various RAG use cases.

answer_2.quote: We estimate the performance of the four retrieval pipelines in terms of HITS@k in Fig. , measuring the percentage of times at least a relevant passage is in the top-k retrieved ones, and Precision@k in Fig. , measuring the average percentage of relevant passages in the top-k retrieved ones.

answer_3.quote: Following related work , we evaluate passage relevance and answer quality using the LLM-as-a-judge approach.
